_doc: Motedis' laser-cut aluminium T plate for 20 mm profiles, 58 x 58 x 3 mm with five 5.5 mm holes on a 20 mm pitch: three along the bar (b) and two up the stem (a). Fixed with M5x8 cap screws into hammer nuts in a 6 mm B-type slot. Sizes from Motedis' drawing, the price from its shop page.
name: fitting-motedis-plate-t-20

fitting_kind.rule: A flat joining plate over a join, on the faces of both beams
fitting_kind.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

plate_shape.rule: A T: its bar along b, its stem along a
plate_shape.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er; Motedis, Verbinderplatte 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_LP20111.pdf

series.rule: Made for 20 mm profiles ("20er"): holes on a 20 mm pitch
series.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er; Motedis, Verbinderplatte 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_LP20111.pdf

slot.rule: Motedis sells its fixing set for B-type slot 6 (and another for I-type slot 5)
slot.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

material.value: aluminium AlMg3 (EN AW-5754 H111), laser cut
material.rule: As the shop page names it (it writes 5457)
material.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

thread.rule: The fixing set for B-type slot 6: 5 x DIN 912 M5x8 and 5 x hammer nut B-type slot 6 [M5]
thread.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

screw_form.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

screw_length.rule: M5x8, as the fixing set lists
screw_length.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

screw_count.rule: Five holes, a screw in each
screw_count.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er; Motedis, Verbinderplatte 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_LP20111.pdf

nut_kind.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

width.rule: Across the bar: 58 mm, dimensioned on the drawing

leg.rule: Bar and stem each 58 mm overall, dimensioned on the drawing

holes_b.rule: The bar's three holes, from its middle: 20 mm apart, 9 mm in from each side (dimensioned), on b's face's middle line

holes_a.rule: The stem's two holes, 20 and 40 mm from the bar's middle hole (the 20 is dimensioned; the second sits 9 mm from the stem's end as the bar's do)

cost.rule: One plate in a pack of 10: 12.09 EUR the pack with 20% VAT (10.07 EUR without), on the date checked; screws and nuts apart
cost.source: Motedis, Verbinderplatte Alu gelasert 58x58x3 -T- 5-loch 20er, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Verbinderplatte-Alu-gelasert-58x58x3-T-5-loch-20er

bending_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this plate, its five screws tight, holds a beam's end against turning across its axis, its screws tight. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess for this kind of join (JOIN_STIFFNESS.gusset), until the joint rig measures it
bending_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it

twist_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this plate, its five screws tight, holds a beam's end against twisting about its own axis. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess (JOIN_STIFFNESS.gusset), until the joint rig measures it
twist_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it
